name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types in PostgreSQL: arrays, composite types and jsonb. PostgreSQL has no map type, so the map columns and the list of maps are jsonb. The dialectType of a composite column is its structure (ROW(...)), the type name is in the description; typeFamily is the family of the root.

columns.name: tags
columns.label: Tags
columns.description: List of text values; elements are addressed 1-based

columns.name: scores
columns.label: Scores
columns.description: List of integers; numeric elements for lambda arithmetic

columns.name: vec
columns.label: Vector
columns.description: Array of three doubles; PostgreSQL arrays have no fixed size

columns.name: matrix
columns.label: Matrix
columns.description: One two-dimensional array of two rows of three doubles, not an array of arrays; the first index selects the row

columns.name: dims
columns.label: Dimensions
columns.description: Flat composite type cx_dims of width and height
columns.dialectType: ROW(w DOUBLE PRECISION, h DOUBLE PRECISION)

columns.name: address
columns.label: Address
columns.description: Composite type cx_address holding a nested composite (cx_geo) and a list (phones)
columns.dialectType: ROW(street TEXT, geo ROW(lat DOUBLE PRECISION, lon DOUBLE PRECISION), phones TEXT[])

columns.name: attrs
columns.label: Attributes
columns.description: Map as a JSON object with text keys; PostgreSQL has no map type

columns.name: counts
columns.label: Counts
columns.description: Map as a JSON object with numeric values; PostgreSQL has no map type

columns.name: lookup
columns.label: Lookup
columns.description: Map as a JSON object; the integer keys are text, as JSON has no other

columns.name: items
columns.label: Items
columns.description: Array of composite type cx_item: sku, quantity, price and a list of options
columns.dialectType: ROW(sku TEXT, qty INTEGER, price NUMERIC(10,2), opts TEXT[])[]

columns.name: events
columns.label: Events
columns.description: Array of composite type cx_event with temporal fields

columns.name: deep
columns.label: Deep
columns.description: A list of maps whose values are structures holding a list and a map of lists; jsonb as a whole, since it contains maps

columns.name: doc
columns.label: Document
columns.description: jsonb document; JSON paths count from 0, arrays from 1

columns.name: odd
columns.label: Odd
columns.description: Composite type cx_odd with a mixed-case field name that needs quoting
